title: Community supermarket opens in shopping centre
summary: A new social supermarket has opened in a shopping centre, offering shoppers access to budget-friendly groceries. This community retail initiative provides affordable food options to local residents.
content: Shoppers can access a wealth of budget-friendly groceries at the new social supermarket.

zh.title: 社区超市在购物中心开业
zh.summary: 一家新的社区超市在购物中心开业，为购物者提供平价食品杂货。这项社区零售举措为当地居民提供负担得起的食品选择。

title: World Bank warns of AI concentration risks as it lifts East Asia and Pacific growth outlook to 4.5%
summary: The World Bank raised its growth forecast for East Asia and Pacific to 4.5% this year, but warned about risks from concentration in AI-related goods. Trade growth outside AI has been weak or negative, signaling regional economies are becoming increasingly reliant on AI-driven commerce.
content: The World Bank now expects the region to grow 4.5% this year, but flagged that trade growth outside AI-related goods has been "weak or negative."

zh.title: 世界银行警告人工智能集中风险，同时将东亚和太平洋增长前景上调至4.5%
zh.summary: 世界银行将东亚和太平洋今年的增长预测提升至4.5%，但警告了人工智能相关商品集中带来的风险。人工智能以外的贸易增长疲弱或为负，表明区域经济越来越依赖于人工智能驱动的商业。

title: Little room for ‘giving and taking’: India’s finance minister confirms trade impasse with the U.S.
summary: India's finance minister acknowledged a stalled trade negotiation with the United States, stating there is little room for compromise. The statement signals growing uncertainty about reaching a bilateral trade agreement between the two nations.
content: In the latest sign of growing skepticism around the closure of the trade deal between New Delhi and Washington, an Indian minister said there is little room for ‘giving and taking.’

zh.title: "让步空间不大"：印度财政部长确认与美国贸易僵局
zh.summary: 印度财政部长承认与美国的贸易谈判陷入停滞，表示几乎没有妥协的余地。该声明表明两国达成双边贸易协议的前景越来越不确定。

title: Pentagon says Trump approves Army firing squad execution of Fort Hood killer Nidal Hasan
summary: The Pentagon announced that President Trump has approved the execution of former Army Maj. Nidal Hasan by firing squad for the 2009 Fort Hood shooting. Hasan was convicted by court-martial of killing 13 and wounding 32 others at the Texas military base.
content: Former Army Maj. Nidal Hassan was sentenced to death after a court-martial that convicted him of killing 13 and wounding 32 others at an Army base in Texas.

zh.title: 五角大楼称特朗普批准对胡德堡杀手尼达尔·哈桑进行枪决
zh.summary: 五角大楼宣布特朗普总统已批准对前陆军少校尼达尔·哈桑进行枪决，以回应2009年胡德堡枪击事件。哈桑被军事法庭裁定在这次德克萨斯军事基地事件中杀死13人、伤害32人。

title: Trump offers U.S. help to Russia after plague death; WHO assesses the situation as low risk
summary: President Trump offered U.S. assistance to Russia following a plague-related death, while the World Health Organization assessed the public health risk as low. The WHO said it was in contact with Russian authorities and remains prepared to provide support if needed.
content: WHO said it was in contact with Russian authorities, and has offered support if needed, while assessing the risk to the general public as low based on available information.

zh.title: 特朗普在鼠疫死亡后向俄罗斯提供美国援助；世卫组织评估风险较低
zh.summary: 在与鼠疫相关的死亡事件后，特朗普总统向俄罗斯提供美国援助，而世界卫生组织评估公共卫生风险较低。世卫组织表示正在与俄罗斯当局保持联系，并准备好在必要时提供支持。
